P.F. 52095/B.4.c. B.13.

I thank you for your internal memorandum of yesterday enclosing a copy of a letter from S.O.2., ECW/KV/657, dated 25.3.41.

S.O.2. have not, however, dealt in any way with the portions of my letter of 18.3.41 relating to Stanislas RETZLAW and I should be glad if you would kindly ask them to do so as early as possible.

I particularly want to know why RETZLAW is associating with SZYMONCZYK and what is the opinion of S.O.2. upon RETZLAW's reliability from the security point of view.

27.3.41.
